title: Owens takes an Eagles fullback out of a game

tellings.quote: middle of the game, Owens said, "I'm going to take out this player, told the reporter."

plain: A man named Ted Owens is said to have told a sports writer, in the middle of a Philadelphia Eagles game, "I'm going to take out this player," after which an Eagles fullback was taken out of the game, and the writer reported it in a newspaper article. Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD and studies psychic claims, tells Michels this as Owens's story passed on to him. If true, it would suggest Owens could affect events at a distance by intention.
